Class SettingsTab

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.settings.SettingsTab
public final class SettingsTab extends Object
One tab of the Tempest settings menu. Each mod registers its own tab with CasinoSettings.

Admins with tempest.admin see every tab. Staff with tempest.admin.<group> see only the tabs of that group, so a moderator can be given tempest.admin.crates without the economy settings.

  • Constructor Details

    • SettingsTab

      public SettingsTab(String title, List<Setting> settings, Runnable onSave)
      A tab in the group named after its title ("Slot Machine" is slotmachine).
      Parameters:
      title - the text on the tab
      settings - up to MAX_SETTINGS settings, shown top to bottom
      onSave - run after an admin saves this tab and the new values have been applied

    • SettingsTab

      public SettingsTab(String title, String group, List<Setting> settings, Runnable onSave)
      Parameters:
      group - the plugin's short name, lower case (coins), for the permission tempest.admin.<group>; give every tab of one plugin the same group
